items.title: Gorensteinness at a point is stable under base change and reflects it under flatness hypotheses
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter duality.tex (Duality for Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y whose fibres are locally Noetherian, a base change Y' -> Y locally of finite type with f' : X' -> Y', and points x' in X' over x in X, the lemma asserts three implications: f Gorenstein at x implies f' Gorenstein at x'; f flat at x together with f' Gorenstein at x' implies f Gorenstein at x; and Y' -> Y flat at f'(x') together with f' Gorenstein at x' implies f Gorenstein at x (statement lines 6613-6628). The proof first notes that the assumption on Y' -> Y makes the residue field extensions finitely generated, so all fibres of f' are locally Noetherian by Varieties, Lemma labelled varieties-lemma-locally-Noetherian-base-change, and records the commutative square of local rings in which the upper left corner is a localisation of the tensor product of the other three (proof lines 6630-6646). For (1), flatness of O_{Y,y} -> O_{X,x} implies flatness of the base changed map by Algebra, Lemma labelled algebra-lemma-base-change-flat-up-down, and Gorensteinness of the fibre O_{X,x}/m_yO_{X,x} passes to the base changed fibre by Lemma labelled lemma-gorenstein-base-change (proof lines 6648-6658). For (2) and (3) the proof uses Lemma labelled lemma-gorenstein-base-change in the opposite direction to deduce that the fibre O_{X,x}/m_yO_{X,x} is Gorenstein, and uses Algebra, Lemma labelled algebra-lemma-base-change-flat-up-down in the third case to transfer flatness from both O_{Y',y'} -> O_{X',x'} and O_{Y,y} -> O_{Y',y'} to O_{Y,y} -> O_{X,x} (proof lines 6660-6680). Reducing each implication to flatness and Gorensteinness of the fibre, and using the two-directional base change lemma for Gorenstein fibres, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
